summary: 45-year-old Louisville climber fell ~15 ft at Happy Hour Crag on Boulder Canyon Drive; found conscious and alert with an injured shoulder and back pain; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Pridemark Ambulance and Sugarloaf Volunteer Fire Department responded; transported to Boulder Community Hospital.
location: Happy Hour Crag, Boulder Canyon Drive
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Pridemark Ambulance; Sugarloaf Volunteer Fire Department
notes: Saturday-verified date; BW police-blotter item "Climber injured after fall"; run 712.
